help: Adds Hyperspace Topography event progress for testing. Progress is capped at the currently installed event's maximum.
Spawns a Starving Threat First or Second Strike near the player in Ashen Verge and immediately attacks the nearest surviving FOB Ithaca bastion.
Spawns three full Starving Threat Third Strike invasion fleets in Ashen Verge; during Labor V this resets their 60-day bastion sieges.
Skips the prerequisite Labors and immediately activates a fresh Labor V defense of FOB Ithaca.
Enables all six Ithaca defense components without changing Labor or research-station progress.
